question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.

WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_quarter_number, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_quarter_number
),
city_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2019_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2020_sales
    FROM city_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_growth
    WHERE (q4_2020_sales - q4_2019_sales) * 1.0 / q4_2019_sales >= 0.20
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.prod_id,
        p.prod_name,
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_quarter_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE co.country_id = 52790
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY p.prod_id, p.prod_name, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_quarter_number
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        prod_name,
        SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, prod_name
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        prod_name,
        total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as row_num,
        COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
    FROM product_totals
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, prod_name
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE row_num * 1.0 / total_count <= 0.20
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.prod_id,
        p.prod_name,
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_quarter_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE co.country_id = 52790
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    AND p.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_products)
    GROUP BY p.prod_id, p.prod_name, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_quarter_number
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        calendar_quarter_number,
        SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_year, calendar_quarter_number
),
product_share AS (
    SELECT 
        pqs.prod_id,
        pqs.prod_name,
        pqs.calendar_year,
        pqs.calendar_quarter_number,
        pqs.product_sales,
        qt.total_sales,
        pqs.product_sales * 1.0 / qt.total_sales as share
    FROM product_quarter_sales pqs
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON pqs.calendar_year = qt.calendar_year AND pqs.calendar_quarter_number = qt.calendar_quarter_number
),
product_share_change AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        prod_name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share END) as share_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share END) as share_2020,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share END) - MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share END) as share_change
    FROM product_share
    GROUP BY prod_id, prod_name
)
SELECT 
    prod_id,
    prod_name,
    share_2019,
    share_2020,
    share_change
FROM product_share_change
ORDER BY share_change DESC
